files.text:
title: Integer calculator
description:
  summary: 'The halve-negative Story halves an already validated negative integer and rounds toward zero. It has no failure mode of its own: missing and non-integer inputs belong to the separate calculator-input
    Story. Negative inputs -6, -7 and -1 produce -3, -3 and 0 respectively.'
roles:
- name: Calculator User
  definition: A person using the calculator CLI
vocabulary:
  forbidden_qualifiers:
  - properly
  - correctly
  - appropriate
  - fast
  forbidden_actions: []
glossary: []
catalogue:
- template: the number is "{value}"
  block: given
  means: The calculator is supplied that already validated integer.
  terms: []
- template: the result is "{value}"
  block: then
  means: The command succeeds and prints exactly that integer, rounded toward zero.
  terms: []
- template: 'the {actor:role} halves the number'
  block: when
  means: The {actor:role} invokes the calculator's halve operation on the number supplied by the given step; the operation divides that number by two toward zero. The resulting value is asserted by the then step, not by this step.
  terms: []

story:
    id: halve-negative
    feature: calculator
    title: Halve negative integers
    as_a: Calculator User
    i_want: to halve an already validated negative integer, rounding toward zero
    so_that: I can calculate half its value
    status: PLANNED
    acceptance_criteria:
        - id: 001-even
          description: The calculator must return -3 when the Calculator User halves -6.
          steps:
            - given:
                - the number is "-6"
            - when:
                - the Calculator User halves the number
            - then:
                - the result is "-3"
        - id: 002-odd
          description: The calculator must return -3 when the Calculator User halves -7.
          steps:
            - given:
                - the number is "-7"
            - when:
                - the Calculator User halves the number
            - then:
                - the result is "-3"
        - id: 003-near-zero
          description: The calculator must return 0 when the Calculator User halves -1.
          steps:
            - given:
                - the number is "-1"
            - when:
                - the Calculator User halves the number
            - then:
                - the result is "0"
